thread:
incident-bot: Pager — high error rate (5xx) on /v1/generate, triggered by canary rollout 2026-03-15T02:00Z. Severity: P2. Paging on-call: @Alice Mendez.

Alice Mendez: ack, I'm up. Looking at metrics now.

Alice Mendez: grafana shows spike starting at 02:01:12 UTC, canary traffic ~10%. Errors look like model load failures.

Zoe Chen: +1 seeing similar in traces. A lot of failed model initializations with KMS errors.

Alice Mendez: logs (excerpt):
```
ERROR 2026-03-15T02:01:13Z model_loader: failed to decrypt model key: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-service-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-rotated-key
stack: /srv/runtime/model_loader.go:142
```

Ravi Patel: FYI deploy-bot shows canary rollout for commit d4f7b9c at 02:00:50. Feature flag `new-model-routing` turned ON for 10% canary.

deploy-bot: canary start ack — commit d4f7b9c, 10% traffic, rule: new-model-routing.

Alice Mendez: sounds like key rotation happened earlier today and the new KMS key hasn't been granted Decrypt to the service-role. Zoe, can you confirm when rotation ran?

Zoe Chen: Rotation job ran at 01:45 UTC. I see rotation logs: key alias updated, but IAM grant step shows warnings: "No matching principal found".

security-bot: Alert — KMS rotation completed by ops/rotation-bot at 01:45:32. IAM grant to role `redwood-service-role` failed (policy mismatch).

Alice Mendez: immediate mitigation plan: 1) Kill feature flag to stop canary traffic. 2) Pause rollout / rollback to previous stable. 3) If kills don't reduce error rate, create emergency IAM policy to allow decrypt for the new key.

Alice Mendez: @deploy-bot please flip `new-model-routing` OFF.

deploy-bot: feature flag `new-model-routing` set to OFF for all traffic (by Alice Mendez) — confirmed at 02:06:02 UTC.

Alice Mendez: checking error rate... still some errors from in-flight requests, but 5xx rate dropping from 12% -> 3%.

Ravi Patel: I'm going to pause the rollout in the control plane and queue a rollback. deploy-bot, initiate rollback to tag release-2026-03-14-stable.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated to release-2026-03-14-stable (requested by Ravi Patel) — estimated completion 02:10:30.

ops-bot: Rolling back canary: terminating 3 canary pods, draining connections.

Alice Mendez: while rollback is in progress, let's prepare the IAM fix. Zoe, can you craft the minimal policy to grant kms:Decrypt to the new key for `redwood-service-role`? Security to approve.

Zoe Chen: minimal policy snippet:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-service-role"},
    "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:DescribeKey"],
    "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-rotated-key"
  }]
}
```

security-bot: Reviewing... minimal widen required for decrypt only. Approve for emergency fix. Please rotate back policy in 24h and open a postmortem.

Ravi Patel: applying policy via console now (manual emergency path).

Ravi Patel: applied, IAM policy attached and key grants updated at 02:12:47 UTC.

Alice Mendez: confirm model loader logs for successful decrypt now.

Alice Mendez: logs (tail):
```
INFO 2026-03-15T02:13:02Z model_loader: decrypted model key successfully for model-x (key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-rotated-key)
INFO 2026-03-15T02:13:03Z model_loader: model-x loaded in 1.2s
```

Zoe Chen: 5xx rate back to baseline (~0.2%). Canary rollback completed at 02:14:55.

Alice Mendez: good. Next steps: 1) Re-enable canary only after rotation job is fixed to grant role properly. 2) Security to perform audit of rotation automation and fix the grant step. 3) Customer impact assessment: CS to notify any affected customers and mark incident timeline.

customer-success: We observed ~18 customer requests failed (mostly trial orgs on canary). Notifying top 5 affected with mitigation note and ETA for follow-up.

customer-success: sample outreach message drafted, sending in 10m after confirmation of rollback.

Ravi Patel: I'll create a short-liveplay to re-run rotation with the correct principal and a dry-run permission check. Also will add an extra automated validation to rotation job to fail loudly if grant step doesn't apply.

security-bot: Recommend rotating the asymmetric key digest if any keys were exposed, but confirmed no exposure — only missing grant.

Alice Mendez: I'm going to hand off on-call to Ravi in 30m. Ravi, you'll take incident lead for postmortem and follow-through on fixes.

Ravi Patel: taking handoff. I'll post a short incident summary and action items to #postmortems within the hour.

Alice Mendez: thanks team. Incident status: mitigated, rollback complete, root cause suspected: KMS rotation automation failed to grant decrypt to service role. Severity downgrade to P3.

incident-bot: Incident updated — state: mitigated. SLA impact: transient increased error rate for ~14 minutes during canary.

Ravi Patel: quick notes for postmortem: timeline, immediate mitigation (flag kill + rollback + emergency grant), follow-ups (fix rotation job, add dry-run check, audit rotation runs, automated smoke test post-rotation). Assigning tasks to Zoe (rotation fix), Security (audit + policy hardening), Deploy (add canary pre-check to prevent rollout during key rotation).

Alice Mendez: handing off paging and alerts to Ravi at 02:30:01 UTC. I'm out for 4h.

Ravi Patel: confirmed handoff received at 02:30:05 UTC. Will coordinate postmortem and customer follow-ups.

customer-success: Sent notifications to impacted customers at 02:38 UTC.

ops-bot: Closing canary session.

Zoe Chen: will follow up with PR to rotation job and include the permission check. ETA: 6 hours for PR + tests.

Ravi Patel: closing notes — create ticket INF-2026-042 for rotation automation fix + link to this thread and logs.

Alice Mendez: thanks everyone.

incident-bot: Thread archived to incidents log.
